_notes: Hand-written 2026-08-31 (#223). Roanoke publishes four true district x use matrices; each is tagged with the principal_uses marker that _ensure_use_table_rows reserves a retrieval slot for, without which a matrix is ranked on token overlap alone and loses the cutoff to its own prose neighbours (the chesapeake-va mechanism, ci_gate.py 2026-08-17). Matched on title only: the scraper stamps every Article 3 section with the same 'DIVISION 1. - RESIDENTIAL DISTRICTS' breadcrumb, so article_contains cannot discriminate here. Each rule carries 'unknown' beside its district family so the matrix clears list_source_chunks_filtered's district filter even when the parcel's district did not resolve (the franklin-tn case). Tagged NARROWLY -- four tables, not every section whose title mentions uses; the reserve is a small number of slots and tagging broadly measures flat (#173).
